summary: Independent review of exact candidate 89326ddaae9db3f6ce59041bb6db3df362318389 reproduced the missing HYV4 attention-TP-gather opt-out on the recorded base and verified that the candidate publishes the opt-out for both HYV4 architectures through the model override registry. The actual gfx950 MoE padded-row mask demonstrated the original consequence: a shard-local valid count of 1 masks 7 of 8 full-width rows, whereas the corrected full-width contract masks none.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before: HYV4ForCausalLM and HYV4ForCausalLMNextN returned no disable_attn_tp_gather declaration; the DeepseekV3 control remained unchanged. See raw/base_override.log.

Independent passing-after configuration matrix: both HYV4 architectures declare the opt-out for deepep, no-A2A, and pure-DP-attention boundaries, while a DeepseekV3 control does not. See raw/candidate_override.log.
Candidate regression and resolution whitelist: 2 tests, 10 subtests passed. See raw/candidate_focused_pytest.log.
On AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, the actual repository MoE mask helper matched an independent reference: valid counts 0, 1, 5, and 8 masked 8, 7, 3, and 0 rows respectively. See raw/gpu_mask_check.log.

tests.what_was_measured: Existing GPU kernel boundaries: 3 tests and 25 subtests passed. See raw/gpu_topk_pytest.log.

91 passed and 4 platform-sensitive tests failed. The same four fail on the recorded base under ROCm, including CUDA/SM100 expectations and unsupported modelopt_fp4; the candidate regression passed. See raw/candidate_full_model_overrides.log and raw/base_platform_failures.log.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 executed the repository's actual MoE padded-row masking path and matched an independent numerical tensor reference.

remaining_limitations: Only one gfx950 GPU was available; TP8/EP8 DeepEP communication was not reproduced.
The Hunyuan-V4-preview weights were unavailable, so no full-model logprob, throughput, or semantic-accuracy comparison is claimed.
The GPU fixture validates the concrete token-masking consequence and the source/configuration contract, not a distributed serving deployment.
No native files changed in the candidate and repository-environment.json specifies no prepared native artifact, so no native rebuild was applicable.
Four unrelated model-override tests fail identically on the recorded base due to this ROCm environment's CUDA/SM100 assumptions and unsupported modelopt_fp4.
